_comment: Season 3 board server (website API + live updates). Game rules live in
packages/board-data/season-config.json; this file is only about running the server.
enabled - set false to stop the board server starting with the bot.
port - local port the server listens on. In production a reverse proxy (caddy/nginx)
forwards https://board.fiovivor.org to it.
public_url - the address browsers use to reach this server. Discord OAuth redirects to
<public_url>/auth/callback, which must also be added in the Discord developer portal.
site_url - the website's board page. Login sends players back here.
allowed_origins - websites allowed to call the API and open live connections.
guild_id / host_role_id - who counts as a host: anyone with this role in this server.
host_user_ids - extra host Discord user IDs, for testing or emergencies.
data_dir - where board state and logs are saved, relative to the bot folder.
session_days - how long a website login lasts.
Local testing: put any of these keys in config/board.local.json (gitignored) to override
them on your machine only, e.g. a test server's guild_id/host_role_id and localhost URLs.
Env overrides also work: BOARD_PORT, BOARD_PUBLIC_URL, BOARD_SITE_URL, BOARD_DATA_DIR.
updates_thread - in Discord, the board image stays in the board's channel and every
other message (dice, moves, prompts, turn pings) goes in a thread, where players can
also /roll. {board} in the name becomes the board's name. enabled: false posts
everything in the channel itself.
host_ping_channel_id - when someone buys a tribe advantage, the host role is pinged here
with who bought which one, so the hosts can hand it out.
test_channel_id - testing only, in board.local.json: every board posts in this one channel
instead of its real tribe channel. Leave it out (or null) for the real season.
Secrets go in .env, never here: DISCORD_CLIENT_SECRET, BOARD_SESSION_SECRET.
